scope: Measured image-order contributions from actual Kerr-Newman equatorial intersections in one central detector fixture; no rings are drawn or image orders brightened

fixture.pixel_quadrature: one independently integrated central ray per detector pixel; no selective AA in this diagnostic

interpretation: This 16 by 13.333 rg central fixture is not the full portrait movie or an intrinsic total source luminosity. Percentages depend on crop, time and resolution.
Relative detector sums are proportional to received flux for equal-area screen pixels; absolute mass, distance, luminosity and spectrum are unspecified.
Counterfactual unabsorbed means foreground transmission is set to one while keeping the same local slab angular-emission factor and source. It is not a zero-tau physical model.
Image order counts finite equatorial crossings along a null trajectory; it is not an assigned visible stripe number.
Finite pixel resolution can merge narrow higher-order contributions; nonzero integrated contributions do not guarantee a separately resolved stripe.
The event horizon emits no light. A ray ending in capture can retain foreground emitting intersections.

Per-order review images use the identical fixed display curve and exposure as the final renderer, with no image-order contrast boost. They are temporary ignored review files and never composited into delivery.
calculated_effects: neutral Kerr-Newman null trajectories and image intersections
flowing-emitter frequency shift including radial photon momentum
per-event propagation delays and retarded times
illustrative_choices: neutral test matter and hypothetical large black-hole charge
multiscale advected emissivity and periodically repeated births

transfer_equations.foreground_transmission: product of exp(-tau/mu) over preceding thin intersections; opaque outer disk ends ray
transfer_equations.observed_event_intensity: foreground_transmission times local intensity times g^4

geometry.model: Kerr-Newman null geodesics; all thin-plunge intersections then first opaque outer disk
geometry.charge_definition: q=Q/(M sqrt(4 pi epsilon_0 G)); geometrized Q/M
geometry.disk_matter: neutral test matter; no Lorentz force or plasma response
geometry.spin_alignment: black-hole angular momentum and disk angular momentum both +z; prograde
geometry.integrator: double-precision RK4; Hermite equatorial root followed by partial RK4 event step
geometry.camera_angle_convention: signed degrees about disk x axis; n=(0,-sin(theta),cos(theta))
geometry.camera_screen_basis: e_x=(1,0,0); e_y=(0,cos(theta),sin(theta)); continuous through both poles
geometry.disk_plane_crossing: observer-at-infinity crossing excluded; coplanar rays first enter outer rim
geometry.delay_definition: elapsed coordinate propagation time minus one common observer Kerr-Newman r*; q-r*(hit)
geometry.azimuth: pole-regular angular vector plus backward Kerr-Newman radial frame-dragging integral
geometry.disk_surfaces: same prescribed isotropic surface emission on both faces
geometry.capture_cutoff_safety: cutoff strictly below prograde equatorial photon orbit; no exterior escaping radial turn is discarded
geometry.storage_limit_policy: unresolved overflow raises; test convergence by increasing capacity
geometry.image_order: number of finite equatorial crossings before the emitting event; no artificial bands
geometry.event_order: near to far along a backward ray
geometry.disk_opacity: outer disk opaque; inner plunging sheet transfer prescribed separately
geometry.photon_radial_momentum: future-directed covariant k_r/E = sign(backward du/ds) sqrt(R)/Delta
geometry.radial_momentum_storage: float64 on-shell at stored float32 event radius; branch sign from integrated ray

source_model.radial_profile: zero-stress neutral Kerr-Newman Page-Thorne relative flux outside ISCO; exact azimuthal mean, peak=1

flow.outer_motion: normalized circular four-velocity plus comoving radial tetrad boost; prescribed alpha(H/r)^2 ZAMO circular-speed scaling
flow.plunge_motion: neutral equatorial timelike geodesic with E,L fixed by the finite-drift ISCO launch; Carter constant zero
flow.frequency_shift: g=1/[u^t-lambda*u^phi-(k_r/E)*u^r]; forward covariant photon k_r retained with its radial sign
flow.streamline_coordinate: age and accumulated azimuth relative to ISCO; t-age(r) and phi-azimuth(r) advect along flow
flow.streamline_quadrature: cumulative trapezoid on separate exterior geometric and inner log(r-r+) grids; float64 linear lookup
flow.event_horizon: no emission or timelike emitter is defined on or inside r+

sources.role: Kerr-Newman metric and neutral timelike first integrals
neutral Kerr-Newman inspiral/plunge equations and interpretation
motivation only for the prescribed alpha(H/r)^2 radial drift scaling

source_model.perturbation: positive, analytically mean-normalized localized angular packets on several radial scales, plus a coherent m2 logarithmic spiral; no axisymmetric rings
source_model.angular_kernel: K_n(theta)=(1+cos(theta))^n/[binomial(2n,n)/2^n]; positive, unit mean, finite degree n
source_model.kernel_blending: convex mixtures of degrees1,2,4,8,12; broad packets capped at4; highest active angular degree follows a birth-parcel angular-advection cadence guide
source_model.sampling_bandwidth: 0.99*pi/[1.02*max_future_abs(Omega)*dt_frame]; nine characteristic times per50t_g parcel lifetime; 240 unique frames/cycle; smooth positive-kernel blending, gas frequencies unchanged
source_model.sampling_limit: angular guide only, not a bound on every temporal frequency; radial transport, birth crossfades, retardation and changing viewpoint require separate temporal convergence checks
source_model.normalization: M=(1+C*sum_j w_j*K_j)/(1+C*sum_j w_j), with nonnegative radial weights and unit-mean positive kernels; current/previous fields crossfade convexly
source_model.advection: r_birth=age^-1(age(r)-birth_age); backward along the same normalized outer drift and neutral geodesic plunge used in photon frequency shifts
source_model.coherence_choice: phenomenological finite lifetime, about a few bright inner orbits; not a calculated MRI correlation time
source_model.birth_blending: current and previous births, complementary sin^2/cos^2 windows; continuous first time derivative
source_model.periodicity: seeded field births repeat every loop_period_tg; gas orbital frequencies are not quantized
source_model.emission_time_rule: t_em=t_obs-delay_tg separately at each photon/source event
source_model.azimuthal_mean: exactly background profile at fixed radius and emitted time, since every perturbation has integer m>=1
source_model.plunge_emissivity: separate prescribed weak heating: plunge_peak_fraction*(1-x)^2, x=(r-rplus)/(rISCO-rplus); zero value/slope at ISCO, finite exterior limit at horizon; no source on/inside horizon
source_model.horizon: no source on or inside rplus; no boundary glow; g^4, photon delays and capture applied by renderer
source_model.surface_emission: identical isotropic thin equatorial source on both sides; optical-depth handling specified by tracer
source_model.dimensional_normalization: none; mass, accretion rate, temperature and spectrum unspecified
illustrative_prescriptions: finite-lived multiscale emissivity packets and a logarithmic spiral
periodic births used to construct an eight-second loop
